head.t: Abbott starts trial of Encantor transcatheter aortic valve
head.x: Abbott has begun the VOYAGER CE single-arm trial of Encantor, a balloon-expandable TAVI valve with software-guided deployment, with the first patient enrolled in Sydney. Results will support approval in Europe and Australia, and the device could complement its self-expanding Navitor valve.

head.t: Abbott gains US FDA approval and CE mark for UltiSynq defibrillation lead
head.x: Abbott has announced that it has received US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval and a CE mark for the UltiSynq defibrillation lead, which is designed for implantation in the left bundle branch area (LBBA) of the heart to deliver both conduction system pacing (CSP) and defibrillation therapy.

head.t: Abbott's conduction system pacing lead gains US and European approvals
head.x: Abbott has regulatory approval in the US and Europe for its UltiSynq lead, used with its ICDs to deliver conduction system pacing as well as shocks by connecting at the left bundle branch area.

head.t: TCT 2026: VERITAS trial reports out to one year for Amulet 360 LAA occluder
head.x: Abbott has announced one-year results for its investigational Amulet 360 left atrial appendage (LAA) occluder from the VERITAS study, which it says show meaningful closure rates of the left atrial appendage and a low incidence of stroke in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF) not caused by a heart valve issue.

f.t: Abbott and J&J report coronary intravascular lithotripsy trial results
f.x: Separate Abbott and Johnson & Johnson MedTech studies of coronary IVL, presented at TCT, showed low complication rates at 30 days and mostly successful lesion crossing.

f.t: TCT 2026 hears early results for Abbott coronary IVL system
f.x: Abbott has reported positive 30-day results from the TECTONIC CAD IVL investigational device exemption (IDE) study, evaluating the use of its investigational SonicForce coronary IVL system.

f.t: CROWN-MV trial of Abbott’s Cephea mitral valve system commences
f.x: Abbott has initiated the CROWN-MV pivotal trial evaluating the safety and effectiveness of its investigational Cephea mitral valve system in treating people with symptomatic mitral valve disease who are not candidates for surgery and transcatheter repair.

f.t: Abbott’s transcatheter PVL occlusion device gains US FDA approval
f.x: Abbott has announced US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval for the Amplatzer Paraclose PVL Occluder, a transcatheter device designed to treat paravalvular leak (PVL)—the backflow of blood around a surgical heart valve.

f.t: Contract awarded: Pricing Agreement - Insulin Pumps & Associated Consumables
Framework ending 26 February 2027: Transcatheter Heart Valve Repair, Replacement and Associated Devices
f.x: Named on NHS Supply Chain's own contract launch brief for this framework, as "Abbott". 11 suppliers on the framework.
